answer: Each submission is a relic appraised only by strangers. An atlas of past interactions - who graded, cited, or co-registered with whom - drives assignment: reviewers come from outside the component of its author, both identities hidden until scores lock. A colluding farm is densely interlinked, so its members recuse one another; every answer needs unconnected outsiders who stake reputation slashed on drift from settlement. New Sybils remain in that component via shared devices and funding. The only bridge is real independent judgment, paid per answer.
